system.description:
Repudiate: You can interrupt a
technological, digital, or techno effect
taking place. Make a Reaction Roll
using your Interface trait. Once per rest
on a success, the effect stops and any
consequences are avoided.
Deploy Construct: Spend a Hope to
deploy an animated construct, drone
cluster, jury-rigged machine, or
autonomous hardware unit from them
that obeys basic commands. Make an
Interface Roll to command them to
take action. When necessary, they
share your Evasion and traits, and their
attacks deal 2d10+3 physical damage.
You can only maintain one construct at
a time, and they fall apart when they
take any amount of damage.
